senses.gloss:
लेहः [लिह्-घञ्]
1 Licking,
sipper; as in मधुनो लेहः Bk. 6. 82.
--2
Tasting.
--3 A lambative, an
electuary.
--4 Food.
--5 One of the
ways in which an eclipse occurs.
--ही A disease of the tips of the
ears.

लेहनं Licking, sipping with the
tongue.

लेह्य a. To be licked, to be eaten
by licking, to be lapped up.
--ह्यं
1
Anything to be eaten by licking
(as an article of food), a
lambative; nectar.
--2 Food in general.
